'''''Shield of Lies''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel that was written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]]. It is the second novel of ''[[The Black Fleet Crisis]]'' trilogy, and it was published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[September]], [[1996]]. It was followed by ''[[Tyrant's Test]]'' later that year.
